claim.value: Censored accounts may leave effects unresolved.
claim.scope: A possible limitation from incomplete follow-up, not a claim that any censoring necessarily prevents inference.

provenance.rationale: P028 explicitly identifies censored accounts as a possible reason effects remain unresolved.

signal_basis.value: At the specified follow-up limits, unfinished trajectories are marked as censored and reported alongside published accounts; the release comparison measures publication rates and timing within a common window.
signal_basis.scope: Incomplete trajectories in the mapped cohort and release comparison under the stated follow-up rules.

provenance.rationale: These spans specify the censoring rules, inclusion of incomplete follow-up in reporting, and publication outcomes being compared.
The claim is supported without a separate unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Censoring can limit information about publication outcomes and timing enough to leave an effect insufficiently determined, even when the observation protocol is executed correctly. This licenses the claim's bounded possibility without implying that censoring always prevents inference.
uncertainty: The packet does not establish whether the amount or pattern of censoring would actually leave this comparison unresolved; the claim asserts only that it may.
